findings.plan_section: 7 rule 11 vs 5 (A6) — verdict mapping can yield a false full PASS
findings.evidence: PLAN_fx_futures_frontier_v1.md line 205-206 (§5 A6: 'Every attack dispositioned with evidence or CONCEDED; an unresolved BINDING attack maps to BLOCKED_* ... or PASS_DATA_CONTROL_ONLY / ANCESTRY_DEAD (mechanism layer) per §7') vs line 264-268 (rule 11: '... + A6 binding attacks all dispositioned + ... -> PASS_FX_FUTURES_RESEARCH_AUTHORITY'). §5 names CONCEDED as a disposition outcome; rule 11 requires only that binding attacks be 'all dispositioned'. First-match order puts rule 11 BEFORE rule 12, and rule 12 is the only rule that catches 'a binding A6 attack on the mechanism layer'. Therefore a cycle with a CONCEDED (upheld, unresolved) mechanism-layer BINDING attack, all R1-R15 PASS and one candidate passing D2-11/12/13, matches rule 11 on its literal text and returns the full PASS — the only verdict that permits writing a scored successor plan — where §5 mandates PASS_DATA_CONTROL_ONLY/BLOCKED. A false PASS_FX_FUTURES_RESEARCH_AUTHORITY is reachable by good-faith reading, so HIGH.
findings.required_fix: Reword rule 11 to 'A6 BINDING attacks all RESOLVED WITH EVIDENCE; zero CONCEDED/unresolved', and/or insert a negative rule before rule 11: 'Any CONCEDED BINDING attack -> per §5 mapping (BLOCKED_* data/cost; PASS_DATA_CONTROL_ONLY or ANCESTRY_DEAD mechanism), never a PASS class.' Then fresh-context A7 re-audit.
